svg.title: Wayfarer's Cache — a fictional card layout study by Hx Works
svg.desc: Self-initiated layout, not a client project. Text, frame, badges and ornaments are editable SVG elements. Embedded AI-assisted raster chest art is reused unchanged from the author's own October 14 study. Fictional rules, no playtest or print-production claim.
svg.text: A small comfort for the road.
